# jymer1102 | Jackson Weimer

> The official website and portfolio of Jackson Weimer (jymer1102): creator, designer, developer, pilot, businessman, and triathlete.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://jymer1102.com/): Introduction to Jackson Weimer (jymer1102), covering academics, athletics, development, aviation, and faith.
- [Creations](https://jymer1102.com/creations/): Collection of apps, web games, and projects built by Jackson Weimer.
- [Connect](https://jymer1102.com/connect/): Contact information, direct messaging form, email link, and social profiles.
- [Playground](https://jymer1102.com/playground/): Interactive live HTML, CSS, and JavaScript sandbox in the browser.

## Featured Creations & Projects

- [agent1102](https://agent1102.onrender.com/): An interactive AI companion experience web application.
- [Screen Pet](https://screen-pet.base44.app/): An interactive virtual companion that lives inside your browser window.
- [Blob Fidget](https://jymer1102.github.io/Blob-Fidget/): A physics-based interactive visual blob widget.
- [Note Pets](https://jymer1102.github.io/Note-Pets/): An interactive notes app attaching reminders to fun virtual pets.
- [Tag Mania](https://jymer1102.github.io/Tag-Mania/): A fast-paced arcade tag chase game for playing against friends or bots.
- **Zombified** *(In Progress)*: An upcoming 3D web shooter featuring browser-based arena combat.
